result.topic_en: Gauss evaluates measurements from turning an instrument (divided circle) through four positions 90° apart, gives a correction formula and its mean error, tabulates a repeated turning of March 1827, computes the mean and mean error, fits a sinusoidal error term, and then notes that the earlier formula is wrong and states a corrected one.

methods.what: Formula for the division error at four positions 90° apart from two sets of readings, with the corrections summing to zero
Mean error of the determination equals half the mean error of a single reading
methods.quote: Der mittlere Fehler dieser Bestimmung ist $=\frac{1}{2}m$

methods.what: Mean of the readings and mean error from the sum of squared deviations
Fitting a first-harmonic (sine/cosine) term to the errors and converting it to a different angular origin
Corrected formula for the division error
